title: Replying to @The Abstract By Sasha I recorded this before @Kate Reink...
transcript: So there actually is an app like Letterboxd and GoodReads but for theatre That already exists, but funny enough it's not what I personally use to track my theatre going. The app is called Mezzanine, and the reason I don't use it has nothing to do with anything that I have against the app. I've heard that it's great. The thing is that by the time the app came out in like 2020 or so, I already had over a decades worth of extensive documentation of the shows I had seen in lists and spreadsheets. And I keep a a private theatre journal. And if Mezzanine is even half as good as Letterboxd, I have no doubt that it's a much cleaner and more organized way to keep all the stuff than what I have. But without an easy way to transfer it all over, it just didn't feel worth it to me personally. So to answer your actual question, how I figured out the stat in my last video about the shortest gaps in between seeing two different productions of the same material is that I have a list for that, basically. Sort of. I have a list of every play or musical that I've seen a more than one production of, and you can see I have the title and the productions listed underneath it. They don't have dates on it though, so I did kinda have to eyeball it based on which ones I just remember being close together in time, then I cross referenced by searching in my theatre journal, which I now type. But I used to write these by hand and then photograph the pages to preserve them, and so I use the dates here and calculated with those
